title: WebSource
description: Provenance record for material acquired from the web. Web-acquired content is a derived, labeled representation — never canonical authority (PAT-003). The trust_label and content_hash make this boundary auditable (Fase 1, DEC-002).

source_url.description: Original URL from which the content was fetched.

canonical_url.description: Canonical URL after redirect resolution, if different from source_url.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the raw fetched content (before any parsing or transformation).

license.description: Detected license or usage terms, if available. null when unknown.

trust_label.description: Trust classification. high: established primary source; medium: reputable secondary; low: user-generated or unknown; unverified: no signal.

content_type.description: MIME type of the fetched content.

research_request_id.description: The ResearchRequest that authorized this fetch, if any.

artifact_id.description: Landing artifact_id if the content was ingested into the pipeline.
